title: deduplicate_rows: remove duplicate rows
description: Remove duplicate rows using either all columns or a subset of columns. Use this when the user asks to deduplicate, remove duplicate records, or keep one row per key.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Subset of columns used to identify duplicates. Empty means all columns.

parameters.name: keep
parameters.description: Which duplicate to keep: first or last.

rag_note: If the user does not name duplicate key columns, use columns: [] to deduplicate across all columns.
